title: TSN OaaS Standardized Optimizer Request Contract v1.4
description: Standardized TSN Optimization-as-a-Service request aligned with OpenCNC protobuf models where semantics match. CNC forwarding-plane state is carried in an OpenCNC-style ForwardingPlaneModel; optimizer-selection and optimization-only concepts remain explicit OaaS extensions.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the standardized optimizer request contract.

mechanisms.description: TSN mechanism or mechanisms involved in the optimization request, together with optional mechanism-specific optimization constraints.

applications.description: Logical application endpoints used when talker/listener placement is modeled explicitly.

capabilities.description: What the physical network CAN do. Describes hardware and forwarding capabilities of devices and ports, including supported TSN mechanisms and timing limitations.

reliability.description: Optional reliability requirements for the optimization request, including FRER redundancy and replication/elimination behavior.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors such as VS Code for validation, autocomplete, and hover documentation.

forwardingPlane.description: OpenCNC-style forwarding-plane input model containing topology, current configuration, and stream definitions/configurations.

dependencyGroups.description: Optional OaaS-specific inter-stream dependencies. These are optimization requirements, not fields of the CNC ForwardingPlaneModel.

target.description: Stream groups. Each inner array contains stream IDs. Outer array order matters for sequencing and cyclic spacing.

metric.description: OpenCNC OptimizationTask.Metric where a direct equivalent exists. OAAS_* values are retained extensions for framework objectives without a direct CNC metric.

priority.description: Lower number means higher priority, aligned with OpenCNC Objective.priority.

weight.description: Optional weight for objectives with equal priority, aligned with OpenCNC Objective.weight.

parameters.description: OaaS extension for objective-specific parameters such as change costs.

bandwidth_mbps.description: Link bandwidth in megabits per second (Mbps), following OpenCNC Link.bandwidth_mbps.

streamDecisionVariables.description: Optional per-stream optimization control. It allows the CNC to freeze or optimize individual aspects of a specific stream independently of other streams.

path.description: Direct OpenCNC StreamConfiguration.path. Suitable when a single explicit path is sufficient.

listenerPaths.description: OaaS extension for listener-specific paths in multi-listener streams. TODO (CNC integration): OpenCNC StreamConfiguration supports a single path array. Define how listenerPaths will be translated into CNC-compatible paths before integration.

frer.description: OpenCNC StreamConfiguration.frer; detailed FRER configuration remains owned by OpenCNC.

cbsOptimizationConstraints.description: Optimization constraints associated with the mechanism identified by the enclosing mechanism request.

maxBestEffortFrameSizeBytes.description: Maximum frame size in bytes of lower-priority traffic that may block the CBS traffic class.

metadata.description: Tracing and experiment metadata. It should not alter optimization semantics.

trafficClasses.description: OaaS extension retained because the seven scenarios target logical traffic classes and OpenCNC Scope currently has no traffic-class field.

transitTime.description: Forwarding delay between completion of frame reception at an ingress port and the earliest time the frame is eligible to begin transmission at the relevant egress port. Serialization time on the outgoing link is not included in transitTime.

fixedNs.description: Single deterministic forwarding/transit time in nanoseconds.

maxGclEntries.description: Maximum number of GCL entries supported by the device or port.

minGateOpenTimeNs.description: Minimum supported TAS gate-open duration in nanoseconds.

minCycleTimeNs.description: Minimum TAS cycle time supported by the device or port.

maxCycleTimeNs.description: Maximum TAS cycle time supported by the device or port.

cycleTimeGranularityNs.description: Supported TAS cycle-time granularity in nanoseconds.

maxHyperperiodNs.description: Maximum supported scheduling hyperperiod in nanoseconds.

guardBandPolicy.description: Device-specific guard-band requirement or policy relevant to TAS scheduling.

framePreemptionSupported.description: Whether frame preemption is supported for scheduling on this device or port.

maxSimultaneouslyOpenQueues.description: Maximum number of queues whose gates may be open simultaneously.

supportedQueues.description: Physical egress queue IDs that support CBS.

maxIdleSlopeBps.description: Maximum CBS idleSlope representable by the hardware in bits per second.

idleSlopeGranularityBps.description: Hardware granularity for CBS idleSlope values in bits per second.

maxCbsQueues.description: Maximum number of physical egress queues that can simultaneously use CBS.

nodeId.description: Node ID whose physical TSN capabilities are described.

ports.description: Optional per-port capability overrides. Port values override corresponding device-level capabilities.

mode.description: Defines whether the replication/elimination location is fixed by the request or selected by the optimizer.

node.description: Fixed node at which replication or elimination occurs when mode is fixed.

allowedNodes.description: Optional set of nodes at which replication or elimination is allowed.

copies.description: Required number of redundant copies or paths.

maxDifferentialDelayNs.description: Maximum permitted differential delay between redundant copies.

mode.description: Defines whether the application endpoint is fixed to a physical end system or may be placed by the optimizer.

node.description: Physical end-system node hosting the application when placement is fixed.

candidates.description: Candidate physical end systems on which the optimizer may place this application.

port_speed.description: OpenCNC InterfaceCapabilities.port_speed; current active speed in Mbps.

macAddress.description: Talker MAC address, aligned with OpenCNC stream.StreamId.mac_address.

uniqueId.description: Numeric stream identifier, aligned with OpenCNC stream.StreamId.unique_id.

maxFrameSize.description: Maximum frame size in bytes, aligned with OpenCNC TrafficSpecification.max_frame_size.

maxIntervalFrames.description: Maximum frames per interval, aligned with OpenCNC TrafficSpecification.max_interval_frames.

intervalNs.description: Traffic interval in nanoseconds, aligned with OpenCNC TrafficSpecification.interval_ns.

serializationOverheadBytes.description: OaaS extension: Ethernet preamble/SFD bytes used by optimizers for serialization occupancy. No direct field exists in OpenCNC stream.proto.

interFrameGapBytes.description: OaaS extension: Ethernet IFG represented as byte-time for occupancy calculations. No direct field exists in OpenCNC stream.proto.

maxLatencyNs.description: Maximum end-to-end latency in ns, aligned with OpenCNC UserToNetworkRequirements.max_latency_ns.

maxJitterNs.description: Maximum allowed jitter in ns, aligned with OpenCNC UserToNetworkRequirements.max_jitter_ns.

numSeamlessTrees.description: Redundancy requirement count, aligned with OpenCNC UserToNetworkRequirements.num_seamless_trees.

hopNumber.description: Hop index aligned with OpenCNC StreamHop.hop_number.

bridgeId.description: Bridge/node identifier aligned with OpenCNC StreamHop.bridge_id.

ingressPortId.description: Ingress port aligned with OpenCNC StreamHop.ingress_port_id.

egressPortId.description: Egress port aligned with OpenCNC StreamHop.egress_port_id.

preserveExistingAdmissions.description: OaaS extension: already admitted streams must remain admitted. This is stronger/more specific than OpenCNC preserve_existing_streams.

extensions.description: OaaS-only limits required by richer reconfiguration scenarios.

operation.description: OaaS extension retaining the framework's generic task category. OpenCNC Intent currently covers configuration/reconfiguration cases but not analysis/validation.

sendSlopeBps.description: PROVISIONAL: Absolute magnitude of the normally negative CBS sendSlope, in bits per second. Compatible with OpenCNC qav.CbsQueueConfig.send_slope_bps (uint64).

loCreditBytes.description: PROVISIONAL: Absolute magnitude of the normally negative CBS loCredit, in bytes. Compatible with OpenCNC qav.CbsQueueConfig.lo_credit_bytes (uint64).

timeInterval.description: Gate interval duration in ns, aligned with OpenCNC qbv.GateControlEntry.time_interval.

gateStates.description: Optional encoded gate-state bitmap corresponding to OpenCNC qbv.GateControlEntry.gate_states. ProtoJSON represents bytes as base64.

openTrafficClasses.description: OaaS extension identifying logical traffic classes associated with this window. OpenCNC GCL stores gate-state bits instead.

streamIds.description: OaaS annotation associating streams with a GCL window; no direct field exists in OpenCNC qbv.GateControlEntry.

cycleTime.description: Cycle duration in ns, aligned with OpenCNC qbv.GateControlList.cycle_time.

pcpMappingEnabled.description: Aligned with OpenCNC PortConfig.pcp_mapping_enabled. TODO (CBS adapter): Check whether PCP mapping is enabled before applying trafficClassTable. Clarify the behavior when pcpMappingEnabled is omitted. Preserve current behavior until resolved.

vlanConfig.description: TODO (CNC integration): Define and validate against OpenCNC vlan.BridgeVlanConfig.

id.description: OaaS stable stream reference key used by framework cross-references. OpenCNC uses a composite StreamId; mapping of the composite identity to this string key is an explicit integration item.

streamId.description: Required canonical OpenCNC stream identity (MAC address + unique ID). Preserved from the optimization request into the optimized ForwardingPlaneModel.

streamRank.description: Optional stream rank aligned with OpenCNC StreamRank.

talkerNodeId.description: Talker node ID, aligned with OpenCNC Stream.talker_node_id.

listenerNodeIds.description: Listener node IDs, aligned with OpenCNC Stream.listener_node_ids.

talkerApplicationId.description: OaaS extension used when talker placement is an optimization variable and no physical talker node exists yet.

listenerApplicationIds.description: OaaS extension used when listener placement is an optimization variable.

frameSpec.description: Optional frame specification aligned with OpenCNC Stream.frame_spec.

trafficSpec.description: Traffic specification aligned with OpenCNC Stream.traffic_spec, plus documented OaaS occupancy extensions.

userToNetworkRequirements.description: QoS/redundancy requirements aligned with OpenCNC Stream.user_to_network_requirements.

trafficClassId.description: Traffic-class reference aligned with OpenCNC Stream.traffic_class_id.

intraClassPriority.description: OaaS extension: relative priority among streams in the same logical traffic class. This is not equivalent to OpenCNC StreamRank.

decisionVariables.description: OaaS extension: identifies which parts of this stream the optimizer may change.

change.description: OaaS extension: per-stream action for mixed reconfiguration requests.
